messages:
Rae (security): Morning — after rolling the new RBAC mapping for keystore principals, eu-west cert unwraps are failing with KMS AccessDenied. Seeing client 502s in the load tests.
Dex (eng-infra): paste a minimal log and the principal ARN if present?
Moe (oncall): sample log:
```
2026-03-27T02:10:12Z proxy-abc ERROR cert_unwrap: KMSAccessDenied arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:555555:key/aaabbb
principal=arn:aws:sts::555555:assumed-role/svc-proxy-eu/session-201 req=cor-55aa
```
Dex (eng-infra): looks like the RBAC change removed the intermediate delegation used by the proxy fleet. quick mitigation: apply a short-lived key-policy grant scoped to the assumed-role arn and region, and restart affected pods. Also bump CERT_CACHE_TTL so proxies serve cached certs while we remediate.
Kai (sre): agree. I'll push a Helm patch to set CERT_CACHE_TTL=600 and enable cached-fallback. Will do a small canary rollout first.
Rae (security): if we add a temp grant, make it via terraform with explicit expiry and create an audit entry containing incident_id=inc-20260327-eu-kms and reason.
audit-bot: Alert logged: keystore.decrypt_error.rate=0.16 @2026-03-27T02:11:00Z. Incident inc-20260327-eu-kms created.
Dex (eng-infra): emergency key-policy snippet (temporary):
```
{
  "Sid":"TempAllowProxyAssumedRole",
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:sts::555555:assumed-role/svc-proxy-eu/*"},
  "Action":["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource":"*",
  "Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:RequestedRegion":"eu-west-1"}}
}
```
Applied with 45m expiry and recorded in infra-audit.
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout proxy-eu v6.0.0 -> v6.0.1 (2/2 updated).
Moe (oncall): after temp grant + canary restart, decrypt success returned to baseline. 502 rate dropped.
Rae (security): follow-ups (RCA & compliance): 1) reconcile RBAC PR to restore a narrowly-scoped delegation or update key policies to reference new service-account principals; 2) add KMS audit fields to cert-fetch logs (assumed_role_arn, kms_key_id, request_id, incident_id); 3) alert rule: keystore.decrypt_fail >5% over 5m -> page; 4) add CI test that validates keystore access during RBAC rollouts.
Kai (sre): I'll draft a postmortem with timeline, IAM diffs, key-policy changes and sample logs. Scheduling incident review.
Rae (security): thanks. tagging INC-6382 for ownership. If anyone sees a recurrence, ping @here.
